messages:
maria-support: FYI escalated from @paul-cs — multiple customers in eu-west are getting a lot of 429s starting ~09:12 UTC. They say traffic is steady (~10rps each) but every request is getting rate-limited. sample req ids: abc123, def456. Also one customer reported unexpected billing spike tied to retries.
paul-cs: customers are mostly small SaaS accounts. they hit 429 on first request after idle period. they tried backoff, still high failure ratio. asked for ETA to unblock.
jordan-sre: assigning — can you drop the logs (X-Request-ID + limiter debug) for one affected customer? curious if tokens are being refilled.
maria-support: pasted logs below from proxy + limiter (redacted):
```
[09:11:58] req abc123 user=acct-789 rps=0.12 limiter: token_count=0 allowed=false reason=burst_exhausted
[09:12:02] req def456 user=acct-789 rps=0.10 limiter: token_count=0 allowed=false reason=burst_exhausted
[09:12:10] req ghi789 user=acct-789 rps=0.09 limiter: token_count=0 refill_ms=60000
```
alex-infra: hmm those logs show bucket_count stuck at 0 and refill_ms=60000 which is suspicious — our limiter config changed during the last infra rollout. I remember a change that converted strings to ints in the YAML and a unit mismatch bug.
jordan-sre: can you point to the exact PR? might be the 02/18 limiter PR that introduced new `burst_window_ms` parsing.
alex-infra: right — PR #837 converted env var parsing and accidentally set `burst_window_ms` default to "60000s" (string) in some builds. runtime was treating it as seconds not ms for the token refill interval which effectively made refill interval 60000s for some nodes. that would explain tokens not refilling.
maria-support: omg that matches. so tokens only refill every ~16 hours on affected hosts. customers saw 429 on first request after idle.
paul-cs: customers asked for compensation (credits) and update. they want a postmortem and ETA to fix.
jordan-sre: mitigation plan: 1) roll a temporary feature-flag patch to treat any invalid `burst_window_ms` as safe default (1000ms) 2) hotfix deploy to all EU nodes 3) temporarily raise per-account soft quota for impacted accounts 4) billing credits drafted.
nina-pm: timeline? we need comms.
ajordan-sre: otoh, canary the fix to 10% eu nodes first. I can push patch in ~30m. will add a healthcheck that validates parsed duration at startup.
alex-infra: creating quick override: set env LIMT_BURST_OVERRIDE=true for accounts list (acct-789, acct-012) to bypass token check. this requires host restart — will coordinate with deploy.
maria-support: please add customers to the bypass list before hotfix if possible. they need immediate unblocking.
deploy-bot: deploy started: limiter-hotfix-1793001234 -> canary (eu-west-1/10%) by alex-infra.
jordan-sre: canary looks good so far, no 429 spikes in canary slice. metrics: limiter.tokens_refill_rate on canary is 1/s (expected). non-canary still shows refill ~0.000016/s.
deploy-bot: deploy successful: limiter-hotfix-1793001234 -> eu-west-1 (100%)
alex-infra: patch landed. runtime now properly parses ms values and falls back to 1000ms on parse errors. I also rotated affected hosts to pick up env override while rollout finished.
maria-support: verified with customers: 429s dropped to near-zero, reported success on 3 accounts. billing team: we need to review spike cause — retries + client backoff contributed to token exhaustion, but root cause is config bug.
paul-cs: customers accepted temporary credits. please prepare formal credit calculation and CS note.
jordan-sre: post-incident actions (short list):
- add strict unit tests for duration parsing + CI gate
- runtime startup validation: fail and log non-zero parse errors (with telemetry)
- add per-account alert when token refill rate < 0.1/s for >5min
- update runbook: how to apply env override and bypass list steps
- schedule blameless postmortem doc by EOD tomorrow (nina to lead comms)
- audit deploys/PRs that touched limiter parsing in last 6 months
- billing: produce credit calc + email template

nina-pm: I'll own comms and runbook updates. can someone add the unit test and CI gate? assigning to alex-infra and jordan-sre.
alex-infra: will open PR for tests and CI check today. also adding a small e2e that simulates idle refills.
jordan-sre: I'll add the alert and dashboard tiles, link them in the postmortem.
maria-support: thanks all — customers unblocked. please tag me in the postmortem doc so I can paste comms. :tada:
